findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "iso20022_bank_transaction_codes" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "iso20022" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: iso20022_bank_transaction_codes · Public sink: iso20022_bank_transaction_codes.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: iso20022_bank_transaction_codes · Public sink: iso20022_bank_transaction_codes

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
